programme.desc: Mary's three suitors include a Turkish diplomat; the former life of Carson, the butler, is revealed.

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece
programme.desc: As he grows into his role as heir, Matthew brings out the rivalry between sisters Mary and Edith; servants Thomas and O'Brien scheme against Bates.

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece
programme.desc: Cora makes a discovery that could throw the inheritance issue into chaos. Under pressure from her aunt, Lady Rosamund Painswick, Mary keeps Matthew waiting for an answer to his proposal.

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece
programme.desc: Matthew and others go off to war, while some try to avoid it.

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece
programme.desc: Downton has been turned into a convalescent home for wounded officers, and there is a lot to do; the arrival of the first patients has everyone scurrying.

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece
programme.desc: Tensions flare between Isobel and Cora over the management of the convalescent home; Ethel's flirtation with Maj. Bryant lands her in more trouble than she could have anticipated.

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece
programme.desc: Bates is taken aback when Vera threatens to expose old secrets which could bring down the Crawleys. Mary is the only one who can protect the family, but she pays a high price when she turns to Carlisle for help.

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece
programme.desc: Isobel has plans for Downton to continue to help the war wounded in some way after Robert's announcement that the ceasefire will begin on Nov. 11.

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece
programme.desc: Spanish flu reaches Downton, and desperate Thomas looks for a way to re-establish himself. Ethel faces a dilemma when the Bryants return with a heartbreaking proposition. Decisive, Anna forces Bates to think about their future.

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece
programme.desc: Tensions arise as Downton Abbey hosts a lavish Christmas party.

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece
programme.desc: Cora's mother sweeps into Downton for Matthew and Mary's wedding, but with the couple's relationship under strain they might not make it to the altar.

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece
programme.desc: Edith is enthusiastic about her wedding and hopes to convince her family that Strallan's age does not matter. With Downton's finances dire because of Robert's actions, Mary takes matters into her hands -- but the personal price may be high.

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece
programme.desc: Branson's political views land him in hot water, and Sybil's loyalty is tested to the limit. Meanwhile, Ethel is torn between head and heart as she makes a difficult decision about her son's future. Elsewhere, Anna is dispirited at Bates' silence.

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece
programme.desc: An exciting offer for Edith divides opinion, Isobel throws Ethel a lifeline, and new maid Ivy is attracting attention below stairs. Meanwhile, Anna's perseverance finally pays off, and Matthew's concerns about the estate grow.

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece
programme.desc: Branson has a strong supporter in his corner after making a tough decision, and Robert and Cora's relationship is under greater pressure.

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece
programme.desc: Change affects many at Downton Abbey; the yearly cricket match settles old scores.

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece
programme.desc: The family travels to Duneagle Castle, while the servants spend Christmas at Downton.

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece
programme.desc: Following Matthew's untimely death, Mary struggles to come to terms with her loss; Edith experiments with modernism.

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece
programme.desc: An extravagant house party at the abbey gives the Crawleys a chance to reconnect with old friends, but some guests prove more welcome than others, and along with the celebrations come deceit and heartache.

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece
programme.desc: Amid the fallout from the eventful house party, Mary faces a pressing question about her future, while Carson reveals surprisingly intimate details of his former life.

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece
programme.desc: Change is in the air when an exciting opportunity for Alfred creates tension between Ivy and Daisy, Isobel appeals to Violet's charitable nature, but it does not come without a struggle, and Branson considers a new future for himself and baby Sybbie.

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece
programme.desc: Cora's playboy brother, Harold, is in trouble, so Robert must travel to America to help bail him out; a new farming venture at Downton sees Blake and Mary putting aside their differences.

programme.title: Downton Abbey on Masterpiece
programme.desc: Rosamund comes up with a plan to help Edith, but Violet, Edith's grandmother, sees right through it; Isobel is the object of someone's attention, while Mary asks Gillingham for a very big favor.

programme.desc: When wild weather strikes, it takes just minutes, or sometimes only seconds, to turn an extraordinary scene into chaos; for unsuspecting onlookers, extreme weather can lead to sheer terror as Mother Nature's wrath descends upon them.

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral
programme.desc: Weather is unpredictable, and can threaten lives without warning; whether it's churning seas, deadly wildfires, or exploding volcanoes, no one is safe when good weather goes bad.

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral
programme.sub-title: In the Blink of an Eye
programme.desc: While it pays to be prepared, sometimes one has to roll with the punches when at the mercy of Mother Nature.

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral
programme.desc: Imagining the horror of being trapped in a tornado, hammered by 30-foot waves, struck by lightning or struggling to stay afloat in a flash flood; only superhuman strength, courage, and the will to survive will help weather this kind of weather.

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral
programme.desc: Mother Nature can melt a road, flood a building or destroy an entire community; from the unexpected to the unforgettable to the downright unbelievable, she's always got something new and different up her sleeve.

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral
programme.desc: Everyone faces challenges on the job, but for those whose work forces them to endure the ravages of Mother Nature, extreme weather makes for an extra rough day at the office.

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral
programme.desc: Weather destroys power grids, floods homes, uproots mature trees, tosses huge trucks like toys and ends lives without remorse; when weather attacks, there's rarely a way to stop it.

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral
programme.desc: In life, everything can change in an instant, and that's never more true than when weather is involved; whether documenting a devastating tornado or intentionally putting oneself in danger, Mother Nature always keeps people on their toes.

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral
programme.desc: Satellites and computer modeling make weather prediction admirably reliable; weather is a complex stew of potent global forces; it can churn itself into an explosive force of terrifying ferocity, one that levels cities and snuffs out lives.

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral
programme.desc: Nature's wrath comes in many forms: torrential, unforgiving rain, a vicious blast of unseen wind, a turbulent, powerful flood; a calm day is worth embracing; nature puts people who aren't careful in their place.

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral
programme.desc: Some weather events are so weird they defy explanation -- even from the most seasoned meteorologists; they're the rarely-seen phenomena that puzzle and capture one's imagination.

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral

programme.desc: While it pays to be prepared, sometimes one has to roll with the punches when at the mercy of Mother Nature.

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral
programme.desc: Imagining the horror of being trapped in a tornado, hammered by 30-foot waves, struck by lightning or struggling to stay afloat in a flash flood; only superhuman strength, courage, and the will to survive will help weather this kind of weather.

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral
programme.desc: Mother Nature can melt a road, flood a building or destroy an entire community; from the unexpected to the unforgettable to the downright unbelievable, she's always got something new and different up her sleeve.

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral

programme.desc: Weather destroys power grids, floods homes, uproots mature trees, tosses huge trucks like toys and ends lives without remorse; when weather attacks, there's rarely a way to stop it.

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral
programme.desc: In life, everything can change in an instant, and that's never more true than when weather is involved; whether documenting a devastating tornado or intentionally putting oneself in danger, Mother Nature always keeps people on their toes.

programme.desc: Satellites and computer modeling make weather prediction admirably reliable; weather is a complex stew of potent global forces; it can churn itself into an explosive force of terrifying ferocity, one that levels cities and snuffs out lives.

programme.title: Sweet Deceit
programme.desc: Host Peck brings holiday decorating fanatics Victor, Joe and Heidi to a big holiday decor warehouse, where cake artist Liz Marek has hidden six hyperrealistic cakes among the seasonal trimmings; if the trio can spot all six, they win $12,000!

programme.title: Sweet Deceit
programme.desc: Host Josh and cake artist Ashley Holt welcome a principal-turned-Santa and two helpers to a house on Christmas Tree Lane; their holiday knowledge is tested as they try to spot which holiday items are real and which are secret treats to win $12,000!

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: In Seattle, Guy visits a joint smoking up ribs and dishing out brisket chili; in Wilmington, N.C., he visits a breakfast spot getting dirty with their biscuits; in Oakland, Calif., Guy visits a spot serving up fried chicken, oxtails and collards.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy digs into everything from pretzels to paella; in Bozeman, Mont., a five-star take on breakfast with a Mexican pork masterpiece; in Little Rock, Ark., a microbrewery serves elevated pub grub; a Mediterranean-inspired restaurant serving up paella.
